'''2008 Australian Championship''' was the ''Star Wars'' CCG national championship of Australia in 2008, the "Australia Nationals", held on 5 July 2008.<ref name="sf-21914-315737">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315737#p315737 Australian and Norwegian events....TC and PB], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 July 2008).</ref> [[Adam Radic]] won and took the automatic bid to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-21914-315847">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315847#p315847 Australian and Norwegian events....TC and PB], Psychobabble, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 July 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Australia
* '''Dates:''' 5 July 2008<ref name="sf-21914-315737" /><ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Radic]]<ref name="sf-21914-315847" />

== Results ==

When Cedric (simone89) asked on 16 July 2008 who had won the Worlds Day 2 auto bid for the Australia Nationals,<ref name="sf-21914-315737" /> the player posting as Psychobabble answered that it was Adam Radic, that he had posted the results in the Australian Nationals forum, and that he had e-mailed the decklists to Scott.<ref name="sf-21914-315847" /> Cedric's list of 2008 Worlds Day 2 auto bids gives "July 5th Australia Nationals Adam Radic".<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
